evidence_now: CFCRSWO-004 URI fleet source test target
what_it_proves: The work-order row is now tested against local URI fleet evidence.
what_remains_open: The target remains fleet-class cash-yield/ROIC proof, not company-level proxy evidence.
next_required_source: Fleet-class OEC, utilization, growth/replacement capex, borrowing-base availability, source-to-purchase allocation and ROIC support.
safe_claim: URI is the cleanest operating-company fleet cash-yield test, but the proof target is stricter than current evidence.

what_it_proves: URI has a large public fleet-cost denominator that can be tested against revenue and cash proxies.
what_remains_open: OEC is not net invested capital, eligible collateral, fleet-class OEC, or average invested capital.
next_required_source: Segment or fleet-class OEC and average OEC schedule.
safe_claim: URI has a public fleet-cost denominator.

evidence_now: Payments for purchases of rental equipment
what_it_proves: Cash moved directly into rental-equipment purchases in H1 2026.
what_remains_open: The payment line does not split growth from replacement or identify whether OCF, debt, ABL, securitization, or sale proceeds funded specific purchases.
next_required_source: Fleet capex split and cash source/use bridge.
safe_claim: URI has direct rental-equipment cash-use evidence.

what_it_proves: Gross rental capex shows material capital deployment into the fleet cycle.
what_remains_open: Gross rental capex is not pure growth capex and is not fleet-class-specific.
next_required_source: Growth versus replacement capex and fleet category schedule.

evidence_now: Proceeds from sales of rental equipment
what_it_proves: Used-equipment sales recycle cash back from the asset base.
what_remains_open: Sale proceeds do not prove asset-class residual value, disposal margin, or life-cycle return.
next_required_source: Used-equipment sale margin, recovery rate, fleet age and proceeds by asset class.
safe_claim: URI has visible fleet recycling cash.

evidence_now: Net cash rental-equipment investment after sale proceeds
what_it_proves: After recycling proceeds, URI still made a large net cash investment in fleet.
what_remains_open: Net investment is not a return metric, not growth-only, and not tied to a fleet class.
next_required_source: Depreciation, gains on sale, growth/replacement bridge and asset-class recovery support.
safe_claim: URI has a net fleet cash investment denominator.

what_it_proves: The 10-Q separates owned-equipment rental revenue from re-rent and ancillary revenue.
what_remains_open: Owned-equipment revenue still does not split rate, time, utilization, and mix.
next_required_source: Owned-rental rate/time/mix and fleet category schedule.

evidence_now: Owned equipment rentals share of equipment rentals
what_it_proves: Most equipment-rental revenue is generated by owned fleet rather than re-rent.
what_remains_open: Owned-rental share does not prove fleet-class return or utilization.
next_required_source: Owned-fleet OEC and utilization by category.
safe_claim: URI's output proxy is mostly tied to owned assets.

what_it_proves: Rental revenue is large relative to the OEC denominator in the quarter.
what_remains_open: This is not ROIC, utilization, rate, or asset-level cash yield.
next_required_source: TTM owned-rental revenue and average OEC by fleet class.
safe_claim: URI has fleet revenue productivity proxy evidence.

what_it_proves: Company-level EBITDA is high relative to the fleet-cost denominator.
what_remains_open: Adjusted EBITDA is not fleet operating profit or ROIC.
next_required_source: Segment EBITDA, operating profit and fleet-class capital denominator.
safe_claim: URI has company profit proxy evidence but not asset-level return.

evidence_now: Specialty equipment-rentals gross margin versus General Rentals
what_it_proves: The 10-Q exposes different segment gross-margin profiles for rental economics.
what_remains_open: Gross margin omits SG&A, interest, tax, depreciation and full capital denominator.
next_required_source: Segment operating profit, EBITDA and OEC by segment.
safe_claim: URI has segment margin evidence but not segment ROIC.

evidence_now: Specialty annualized equipment-rentals gross profit / average segment assets versus General Rentals
what_it_proves: Specialty produces more equipment-rentals gross profit per filed segment asset than General Rentals in the current proxy.
what_remains_open: Segment assets are not fleet OEC and gross profit is not operating income.
next_required_source: Segment OEC, operating profit, average invested capital and category mix.
safe_claim: URI has bounded segment asset-productivity proxy evidence.

evidence_now: Operating cash flow divided by gross rental capex
what_it_proves: Company operating cash flow covered gross rental capex in H1 2026.
what_remains_open: Company OCF does not prove each fleet purchase was internally funded or high-return.
next_required_source: Quarterly cash-flow bridge with debt draws, repayments and fleet purchase classes.
safe_claim: URI has same-period cash coverage evidence.

evidence_now: Operating cash flow divided by net fleet cash investment
what_it_proves: Operating cash flow covered net fleet cash investment after equipment-sale proceeds.
what_remains_open: Net fleet investment depends on sale proceeds and does not identify asset class.
next_required_source: Growth/replacement split, sale proceeds bridge and asset-class recovery.
safe_claim: URI has stronger cash coverage after recycling proceeds.

evidence_now: AR collateral-pool coverage of AR securitization borrowings
what_it_proves: URI's funding stack has visible receivables collateral support alongside fleet investment.
what_remains_open: AR collateral coverage is not ABL borrowing-base proof, legal availability, or fleet collateral value.
next_required_source: Borrowing-base certificates, reserves, advance rates, eligible collateral and availability schedule.
safe_claim: URI has collateral support but not legal borrowing-base proof.

what_it_proves: The work-order row is executed: URI has strong company/fleet proxy evidence that capital moves into rental equipment and returns through owned-rental output, used-equipment sale proceeds, company cash coverage, segment-margin proxies, and collateral support.
what_remains_open: Full fleet-class cash yield remains unproven because growth/replacement capex, fleet-class OEC, true utilization, rate/time/mix, segment operating profit, legal borrowing-base availability, reserves, advance rates, source-to-purchase allocation, and ROIC are missing.
next_required_source: Fleet category OEC, utilization, growth/replacement capex, borrowing-base certificates, collateral reports, segment operating-profit bridge and ROIC support.
safe_claim: URI has strong fleet cash-yield proxy evidence but not full fleet-class cash-yield or ROIC proof.
